captions: Place every single step, journey, and unseen concern beneath the shadow of the Almighty God.
When deep shadows stretch long across your path and uncertain winds blow, rest peacefully in His quiet sweet peace.
Scripture declares in Proverbs eighteen ten, the name of the Lord is a strong tower, the righteous runneth into it and is safe.
Heavenly Father, surround this precious soul with your divine heavenly shield today. Guard their coming and their going, protecting their mind, home, and loved ones from all hidden harm.
Cover them completely with your holy grace, grant them restful courage, and anchor their heart forever in your eternal fortress today. Amen.
